title: Reverse Degree of a String
summary: Determine the reverse degree of a string by multiplying each character's position in the reversed alphabet with its position in the string, then summing these products.
statement: Determine the reverse degree of a string by multiplying each character's position in the reversed alphabet with its position in the string, then summing these products.
constraints: Map a to 26, b to 25, and so on through z to 1.
Multiply each mapped value by its one-indexed position in s.
Return the sum of all products.
reference_solution:
def reverse_degree(s):
    return sum((26-(ord(char)-ord('a')))*position for position,char in enumerate(s,1))
hints: Convert each character to its zero-based ordinary alphabet offset.
Subtract that offset from 26 for its reversed value.
Multiply by the one-based string position.
Summing each independent contribution implements the definition directly.
editorial: Summing each independent contribution implements the definition directly.

tests.explanation: z has reversed value one at position one.
